# Changelog

## 0.1.0

### Initial tester release

- Select up to four macOS windows and inspect their Accessibility text and captured images in Lens.
- Connect a supported Agent and choose its available model and session options in Settings.
- View a settled interpretation while selected sources are monitored, with Pause, Resume, and Stop controls.
- Respond to Agent permission requests and input forms through the application.

### Known limitations

- Apple Silicon and macOS 15.2 or later only; access to this private repository is required.
- The application is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. Initial launch requires explicit macOS approval.
- Updates are manual and may require Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions to be granted again.
- Agent runtimes are downloaded separately. Provider authentication and any applicable provider subscription are required.
- Source extraction and monitoring coverage depend on the selected application's Accessibility support.
